Every government in a parliamentary democracy is influenced by lobbyists. The Canadian system is unusual in that it publishes the influence in real time: the Lobbying Act requires registered lobbyists to file a Communication Report within 15 days of every "oral, arranged communication" with any "designated public office holder" (cabinet ministers, senior officials, MPs, senior staff).
